name: Facet
text: Use Playwright MCP to drive EXCAVA in a single browser engine—Chrome. This guarantees fast, consistent rendering and avoids cross-browser quirks that slow us down. The trade-off is locking to Chrome, but since EXCAVA’s interface is Chrome-first anyway, we gain speed and reliability without real loss.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Chrome-only automation risks hiding EXCAVA’s interface breakage in Firefox or Safari—users won’t see the cracks until they switch engines. Better alternative: run Playwright MCP against Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit nightly to catch cross-engine quirks early; settle the argument by measuring rendering lag and bug reports across all three.
